notes.title: Goal: Early Access
notes.content: [p][b]Friends, after more than a year-long break, we’ve gathered our strength and decided to bring the game to Early Access on our own. We don’t know exactly how long it will take yet—approximately six months, maybe a bit more. Stay tuned for updates! Our main news channel is: [/b][url="https://t.me/mechanoids3"]https://t.me/mechanoids3[/url][/p]
